name: OC&C Strategy Consultants
seo_title: OC&C case interview and online test: what to expect
description: What OC&C's own careers pages say about its online assessment, video assessment and case study interviews, each line linked to its source.
intro: This guide sums up what OC&C Strategy Consultants's own careers pages say about applying and interviewing, from how to apply to how OC&C suggests you prepare. It reflects those pages as we checked them on 16 October 2026. Processes differ by programme, role and country, so check OC&C's careers site for your role before you apply.

items.text: For its London Associate Consultant 2027-28 Strategy role, OC&C says the first step is a CV with your name and contact details removed, and no cover letter is needed.
OC&C says applicants to its London office may apply for only one Associate Consultant role, either Strategy or Analytics.
OC&C's UK careers site says all applications must be made through its website, and you should get a confirmation email within 48 hours.

For its UK graduate internship and Associate Consultant Strategy roles, OC&C says CVs should be one to two pages and are judged on intellectual curiosity, extracurricular interests and commercial awareness.
For its London Associate Consultant Strategy role, OC&C says it screens applications on a rolling basis, reviewing them as they arrive.
OC&C says its London Summer Internship 2027 is only for students in the penultimate year of study, for example the second year of a three-year degree.
On its UK careers site, OC&C says MBA applications open in three windows: August to September and March to April for full-time roles, and October to January for summer internships.

For its London Associate Consultant Strategy role, OC&C says the second stage is an online blended assessment that mixes numerical and critical reasoning questions with behavioural and motivational ones.
For its London Associate Consultant Strategy role, OC&C says candidates who pass the blended assessment are then invited to a short one-way video assessment.
For its London Associate Consultant Analytics role, OC&C adds an online Python coding test and says only basic coding ability is needed.
For its UK Associate Consultant roles, OC&C says you may get the online test link before the vacancy closes, so that not everyone sits the test at once.

For its London Associate Consultant Strategy role, OC&C says the first round is two 30-minute virtual case study interviews with Consultants and Managers, and the second is two 45-minute in-person case study interviews with Associate Partners and Partners.
OC&C lists the same steps for its London Summer Internship 2027: blended assessment, one-way video, two 30-minute virtual case interviews, then two 45-minute in-person case interviews.

For its London Analytics role, OC&C says the first round is two 30-minute virtual interviews with the Analytics team, followed by two 45-minute in-person case study interviews with Associate Partners and Partners.
In its 2024 global graduate brochure, OC&C listed a 90-minute written case study interview with Associate Consultants as part of the process for entry-level roles in its Rotterdam office.
For its London Associate Consultant Strategy role, OC&C says you do not need any previous consulting or business experience.

For its London Associate Consultant Strategy role, OC&C says it looks for logical, numerate problem-solvers who are commercially curious, communicate clearly, work well in teams, take initiative, learn fast, are resilient and have a strong academic record.
For its London Analytics role, OC&C says Python is required, along with a strong academic record, ideally in a subject such as analytics, computer science, maths, statistics or economics.

For its London Associate Consultant Strategy role, OC&C says an AI tool it built itself helps screen CVs, some screening decisions may be made without a person reviewing them first, and final hiring decisions are made by people.
OC&C's applicant privacy notice says that if an automated assessment of an internship or graduate application says it should not go forward, a person reviews that decision before it is final.
On its UK site, OC&C says it uses RARE flags and blind CV screening in its recruitment process.
OC&C's Meet Our People page quotes a consultant who says preparing for case studies is essential, but candidates should also be ready to talk about who they are and why they like OC&C.

practice_advice: Practise saying your structure out loud before you start any analysis, so the interviewer can follow your plan.
Do short, timed mental maths drills most days, with pen and paper only. Mock Partner's drills cover mental maths, chart reading and market sizing.
After each practice case, write down one thing to do better and choose your next case to work on it.
